# Flex Shrink

::: tip 实现进度 90% · 已完成
活示例对标 Amis Flex Shrink：`flex-shrink` / `flex-shrink-0` 落在同一元素的 `flex-shrink`。独立样例 + 三行组合；`m:` / `pc:` 已进 helper，不支持状态前缀。
:::

只改子项的 `flex-shrink`，不改 grow / basis。要先有父级 `display: flex`（见 [Display](/style/layout/display)）。`flex-shrink` 为 1，窄了就挤（也是 CSS 默认）；`flex-shrink-0` 为 0，不挤。Amis 类名带 `flex-` 前缀，不是 Tailwind 的 `shrink`。舞台钉死 `w-56`（224px），盒子 `w-32`（128px）故意放不下。Vamis schema `className` 打在外层 `div.vamis-node`；本页用 HTML 岛把 shrink 类打在子项上。

## 类名

| Class | Properties |
| --- | --- |
| `flex-shrink` | `flex-shrink: 1` |
| `flex-shrink-0` | `flex-shrink: 0` |

## flex-shrink

`flex-shrink: 1`。grow / basis 不动。舞台 `w-56` = 224px，内宽 208px，缝 `gap-2` = 8px，两枚都是 `w-32`（128px）放不下。左枚 `flex-shrink-0` 钉死 128px，右枚被挤到 72px。

```schema
type: tpl
inline: false
tpl: |
  <div class="flex gap-2 w-56 overflow-hidden bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <div class="flex-shrink-0 w-32 h-16 bg-blue-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm p-sm rounded-md whitespace-nowrap">不缩</div>
    <div class="flex-shrink w-32 h-16 bg-yellow-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm p-sm rounded-md whitespace-nowrap">可缩</div>
  </div>
```

```schema: scope="body"
type: code
language: html
value: |-
  <div class="flex gap-2 w-56 overflow-hidden bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <div class="flex-shrink-0 w-32 h-16 bg-blue-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm p-sm rounded-md whitespace-nowrap">不缩</div>
    <div class="flex-shrink w-32 h-16 bg-yellow-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm p-sm rounded-md whitespace-nowrap">可缩</div>
  </div>
```

## flex-shrink-0

`flex-shrink: 0`。不收缩。两枚都钉死 128px，合计超出内宽，`overflow-hidden` 裁掉右枚一部分。

```schema
type: tpl
inline: false
tpl: |
  <div class="flex gap-2 w-56 overflow-hidden bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <div class="flex-shrink-0 w-32 h-16 bg-blue-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm p-sm rounded-md whitespace-nowrap">短</div>
    <div class="flex-shrink-0 w-32 h-16 bg-yellow-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm p-sm rounded-md whitespace-nowrap">长文案</div>
  </div>
```

```schema: scope="body"
type: code
language: html
value: |-
  <div class="flex gap-2 w-56 overflow-hidden bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <div class="flex-shrink-0 w-32 h-16 bg-blue-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm p-sm rounded-md whitespace-nowrap">短</div>
    <div class="flex-shrink-0 w-32 h-16 bg-yellow-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm p-sm rounded-md whitespace-nowrap">长文案</div>
  </div>
```

## 组合

同一组舞台：钉死 + 挤扁、两边都挤（各 100px）、两边都不挤（裁切）。

inline: false
tpl: |

    <div class="flex gap-2 w-56 overflow-hidden bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">

      <div class="flex-shrink w-32 h-16 bg-yellow-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm p-sm rounded-md whitespace-nowrap">长文案</div>
    </div>
    <div class="flex gap-2 w-56 overflow-hidden bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">

## 响应式设计

支持通过添加设备前缀 `m:` 或者 `pc:` 来分别针对「手机端」或者「pc端」设置样式，更多说明请前往[「辅助类-响应式设计」](/style/responsive-design)。窄屏 `m:flex-shrink-0` 不挤；桌面（≥768px）`pc:flex-shrink` 右枚挤到 72px。

```schema
type: tpl
inline: false
tpl: |
  <div class="flex gap-2 w-56 overflow-hidden bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <div class="flex-shrink-0 w-32 h-16 bg-blue-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm p-sm rounded-md whitespace-nowrap">不缩</div>
    <div class="m:flex-shrink-0 pc:flex-shrink w-32 h-16 bg-yellow-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm p-sm rounded-md whitespace-nowrap">可缩</div>
  </div>
```

```schema: scope="body"
type: code
language: html
value: |-
  <div class="flex gap-2 w-56 overflow-hidden bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <div class="flex-shrink-0 w-32 h-16 bg-blue-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm p-sm rounded-md whitespace-nowrap">不缩</div>
    <div class="m:flex-shrink-0 pc:flex-shrink w-32 h-16 bg-yellow-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm p-sm rounded-md whitespace-nowrap">可缩</div>
  </div>
```

## 状态前缀

本页与 Amis 一样：不支持[「状态前缀」](/style/state)。简写见 [Flex](/style/flex/flex)，增长见 [Flex Grow](/style/flex/grow)。

其它 helper 见 [辅助类-响应式设计](/style/responsive-design)、[辅助类-状态样式](/style/state)。
